apps.name: Plezy
apps.subtitle: Modern cross-platform Plex client
apps.localizedDescription: A modern Plex client built with Flutter for native performance and a clean interface. Stream your media library with a beautiful, responsive UI.

versions.localizedDescription:
## New features

- Explore: search the active catalog source directly from the Explore page instead of a separate screen
- Explore cards and detail pages show what the catalogs already return: attributed ratings, leaderboard ranks, audience counts, broadcast slots, next-episode air times, availability and request state
- File Info details every version, file and stream a server reports, including split files, extra versions, dynamic range, Dolby Vision layers, spatial audio and embedded attachments
- New playback setting to follow the server's own audio and subtitle choice for each episode, for libraries curated server-side such as Plex Auto Languages
- Pausing or seeking with the controls hidden now shows a small transient indicator instead of raising the whole player UI over the subtitles you were reading

## Playback

- Forced subtitles stay forced across episode changes, and a track choice that does not fit the next episode falls back to the server's own choice instead of latching onto the wrong track and saving it back
- Double tap to skip requires a fresh double tap every time; a remote or keyboard press no longer arms one-tap seeking, and the side zones raise the controls again
- Keyboard and remote seeks accumulate into one running total like the on-screen skip controls

## Explore

- Plex Discover home shelves now render instead of showing only the Watchlist row
- Titles you own are matched to your library again, and watchlist hearts load and toggle
- Anime and sequel seasons match the show they belong to in your library
- Catalog detail pages are sized to their content: related titles collapse into one compact section, scores appear behind their source's brand mark, and facts flow into columns on wide windows

## Highlights

- **Explore gains AniList, Simkl and Plex catalogs**, alongside the existing Trakt, MyAnimeList and Seerr sources
- **Six new languages** — Turkish, Hungarian, Traditional Chinese, Azerbaijani, Kazakh and Uzbek — with every existing translation brought up to date with the current English text
- **Playback speed now goes up to 8x**, up from 3x
- **Transcoded Plex video behaves like a local file**: seeking no longer reloads the stream, the timeline scrubs as you drag, and switching subtitles is instant
- **Most single-line Apple TV text fields now use the native tvOS keyboard** instead of the in-app overlay keyboard

## New features

- Playback speeds up to 8x (#1545)
- Explore: AniList, Simkl and Plex catalogs, each appearing once the matching account is connected
- Jellyfin: backdrops on detail, Explore and TV spotlight screens cycle through all the artwork on the server
- Detail: the director is listed alongside studio and rating
- Detail: episode cards show the file size
- TV: an Appearance setting shows spotlight artwork in the top-right corner instead of filling the screen, off by default (#1628)
- Downloads: removing a synced playlist or collection can also delete the downloads it made, keeping anything another sync or profile still uses (#1656)
- Downloads: Android warns on the Downloads screen when battery or notification settings would stop downloads in the background, with a button straight to the right system screen
- Six new languages: Turkish, Hungarian, Traditional Chinese, Azerbaijani, Kazakh and Uzbek
- Traditional Chinese shows dates and durations in Traditional characters, Plex sends its text back in Traditional Chinese, and a device set to Traditional Chinese picks it automatically

## Fixed

- Jellyfin home screen offline loops
- Playback crashes on older Android and Fire OS devices
- Back navigation on media and catalog details
- Music volume persistence and mini-player interactions
- D-pad volume and sync sliders
- Keyboard shortcut recording
- Live TV guide long-press actions and recording sheets
- Watch Together leave and end-session actions

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/edde746/plezy/compare/2.9.0...2.9.1
